content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients received any statin in the past year?
I'll query the clinical records database. Let me first check the available tables.

This is an OMOP CDM database. "Statin" is a drug class, so I'll find all statin ingredient concepts and count distinct patients with an exposure in the past year (since 2025-07-23), using `concept_ancestor` to capture all statin descendants.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE c.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
      AND c.concept_code = 'C10AA'   -- HMG CoA reductase inhibitors (statins)
)
AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATE '2025-07-23'
AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATE '2026-07-23'

content.text:
**5,834 patients** received any statin (ATC C10AA, HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors) in the past year (2025-07-23 to 2026-07-23), based on distinct persons with a statin drug exposure in the OMOP database.

Note: this counts by `drug_exposure_start_date`; a prescription started earlier that continued into the window is not included.
